subject: Request: short-term headroom PO and blended overage rate for BrightCart campaign
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
To: Jorge Ramos <jorge@brightcart.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Short-term headroom request for launch spike (72h)

Jorge —

Quick note ahead of BrightCart's weekend paid acquisition push: I understand you expect a 48–72h traffic spike that will exceed your committed throughput. We can provision ephemeral headroom for the window, but I want to confirm commercial terms and required paperwork first so we can flip the switch without delays.

Proposal (initial):
- Window: 2026-08-14 00:00 UTC through 2026-08-16 23:59 UTC (72 hours)
- Capacity uplift: +60% above current committed quota (measured at your monthly baseline)
- Pricing: blended overage rate for the window (we can gate with a daily cap)
- Activation: needs PO from procurement + signed short addendum to subscription terms

I've attached a short ad-hoc rate sheet with examples (ad-hoc-rate-sheet-2026-08.pdf). If this looks reasonable I can have Ben confirm exact numbers and send a proforma invoice for PO.

Goal: confirm by EOD Wed (8/11) so Ops can reserve capacity.

Thanks,

Tessa Morgan
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[t] +1 415 555 0123 | tessa@redwood.com
Redwood Inference — Production-first inference

Attachment: ad-hoc-rate-sheet-2026-08.pdf (PDF, 1 page)

From: Jorge Ramos <jorge@brightcart.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
Cc: BrightCart Procurement <procurement@brightcart.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Short-term headroom request for launch spike (72h)

Tessa —

Thanks for the quick heads up. We do expect a concentrated surge tied to the new campaign creative. Procurement will need a firm number to cut a PO. A couple of clarifications:

1) "Blended overage rate" — can you confirm the final per-token (or per-1000-token) cost we should put on the PO?
2) Billing cadence — will this be invoiced as a one-off true-up after the window, or broken into monthly/near-term invoices?
3) Can you lock the uplift for the exact 72h window only (we have no appetite for a longer commitment).

We can fast-track a PO if you send a clear proforma + the T&Cs addendum.

— Jorge
Jorge Ramos
VP Growth | BrightCart
jorge@brightcart.com

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Jorge Ramos <jorge@brightcart.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2026 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Short-term headroom request for launch spike (72h)

Jorge —

Appreciate the quick reply. Based on the uplift you asked for (+60% for 72h) and your historical token mix, here's a concrete commercial we can cut to PO today: 

Option A (preferred, simplest):
- Blended overage rate for the 72h window: $0.0018 per token (net of discount) — this assumes up to 1.2x your baseline token density; daily cap of $18k/day.
- Billing: one-off true-up invoice issued within 5 business days after the window; Net-30 payment terms.
- Requirement: PO referencing deal BRIGHT-2026-08-UG + signed 1-page headroom addendum (we'll attach).

Option B (conservative):
- Standard overage rate: $0.0026 per token (no daily cap).
- Billing: monthly invoice covering the overage period + Net-30.

Discount: As a gesture for the quick turn, Redwood will extend a 30% discount off standard overage pricing for Option A if PO is received by EOD Thu (8/12).

I've attached a proforma invoice (proforma-invoice-BrightCart-0826.pdf) and the 1-page addendum draft. If you confirm Option A and send PO, Ops will pre-allocate the nodes and enable the uplift at the start of the window.

Ben Carter
Lead, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com | +1 646 555 0199

Attachment: proforma-invoice-BrightCart-0826.pdf (PDF, 1 page)

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Jorge Ramos <jorge@brightcart.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Aug 2026 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Short-term headroom request for launch spike (72h)

Jorge / team —

Couple of operational items from Finance before we can recognize the uplift: 

- PO needs to reference the Redwood billing entity and the deal id (BRIGHT-2026-08-UG). Please include BrightCart's billing address and tax ID on the PO.
- We require the signed 1-page headroom addendum (simple scope + window + pricing) and your purchase order.
- Invoices will be issued after we reconcile actual consumption. If you prefer escrowed prepayment, we can accept a partial prepayment equal to 50% of the proforma and the remainder net-30 after reconciliation — advise if procurement wants that route.
- For any tax withholding or non-US payment instructions, include the remittances on the PO.

Happy to accelerate once we have PO and the addendum. Ops has tentatively reserved the extra capacity but cannot finalize without the PO.

Lauren Bishop
Revenue Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com

From: Jorge Ramos <jorge@brightcart.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Cc: BrightCart Procurement <procurement@brightcart.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Aug 2026 16:45:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Short-term headroom request for launch spike (72h)

Team —

We've routed the PO (BrightCart_PO_8765.pdf attached) to you; it references BRIGHT-2026-08-UG and includes our billing address and tax ID. Procurement approved Option A with the blended rate and daily cap; they'll issue payment terms Net-30 per your proforma.

Requesting confirmation that Redwood will enable the uplift at 00:00 UTC on 2026-08-14 and that Ops has the nodes reserved. Also please confirm the final invoice schedule and whether we need to sign anything else beyond the 1-page addendum.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Jorge

Jorge Ramos
VP Growth | BrightCart
jorge@brightcart.com

Attachment: BrightCart_PO_8765.pdf (PDF, PO, 1 page)
